verdict.rationale: Jina Reader's core purpose is converting any URL into clean, LLM-ready markdown/text via a simple API, handling headless rendering, anti-bot proxies, and format conversion (PDFs, Office docs) behind the scenes, with presets like 'research' tailored for AI agents. Community reports of auth errors/404s reflect account/API-key issues rather than disputing the core clean-text delivery capability.
